about_the_game:
Test your knowledge of world capitals, countries, flags and geography in this fun and educational trivia game!

World Capitals Quizzer has entertained millions of players worldwide. Whether you are a beginner or a geography expert, this game helps you learn, play, and improve your world knowledge while having fun.

Learn the world through play

Explore every corner of the globe with quiz modes covering world capitals, countries, flags, landmarks, currencies and regions. Play short quizzes to sharpen your skills, or tackle harder challenges to become a true geography master.

Features

  • Guess all the world’s capitals and see how many you know

  • Identify countries and their national flags

  • Explore landmarks, famous regions and currencies

  • Learn about national animals, flowers, anthems and historical figures

  • Multiple quiz modes: capitals, flags, states/regions and more

  • Fun, relaxing, and suitable for all ages

  • Challenge your friends or test yourself solo

  • Regular updates with new quizzes and features

Why choose World Capitals Quizzer?

  • Perfect for students who want to study geography

  • Great for quiz and trivia fans who enjoy testing their knowledge

  • Ideal for travellers curious about new countries and cultures

  • Entertaining and educational for players of all ages

World Capitals Quizzer is more than a quiz – it’s a learning journey. Improve your knowledge of world capitals, flags and countries while enjoying an engaging and relaxing gameplay experience.

Play free today and join the global community of trivia fans discovering the world one question at a time!
